description:
Use this when the user wants the raw daily NSE rows for a security, including SME stocks, bonds, G-secs, SGBs or fund units, with delivery and trade counts.

Returns the daily rows NSE published for one security in every series it trades in, newest first: open, high, low, close, volume, turnover, trades and delivery. It covers SME stocks, bonds, government securities, gold bonds and fund units, which get_price_history does not. `symbol` is an NSE symbol or ISIN; `series` narrows to one, such as EQ, BE, SM or GB. The window is `days` back from the latest day held (default 30, at most 1825), or `from_date` and `to_date`. Prices are as published and not adjusted for splits or bonuses: for an adjusted series use get_price_history.
name: get_security_history
title: Daily history, any NSE series
